api_analysis.hypothesis: The numerical failure arises because the head log-softmax is computed over only 5000 columns using the first 5000 rows of head_weight, but the reference AdaptiveLogSoftmaxWithLoss computes head log-softmax over all 5001 head outputs (including the tail cluster logit). The correct procedure is: compute head_logits = x @ head_weight.T (shape [batch, 5001]), then head_log_probs = log_softmax(head_logits, dim=1) (over 5001 classes). For the final output, we concatenate the first 5000 columns of head_log_probs with tail_log_probs (computed independently over 5000 tail classes) to form [batch, 10000]. Our current binding slices head_weight to 5000 rows before the log-softmax, changing the denominator and shifting all head values by a constant. Although the head region (columns 0-4999) may still be within tolerance due to relative differences, the tail region (columns 5000-9999) is offset by approximately log(sum_tail / sum_head) ~ 8-10, causing the observed 50% mismatch. The fix is to compute full 5001-column head log-softmax and then combine correctly.
